summary: The Data Portability Community sideload renders with correct identity and persona scoping (Home/Admin/Messages copy all name the resolved Owner/Admin persona in prose, no raw enums). The judge's dominant, correctly-identified finding -- duplicate 'N components' chips on both the community-backup and partner-handoff package cards -- was root-caused precisely to a real JSON-authoring bug: both export-package and export-schema-listing declared a redundant derived formula field (componentCount = size(includedComponents)) with a labelTemplate nearly identical to, and overlapping displayContexts with, the underlying list field's own labelTemplate. Fixed by removing the redundant fields, re-validated (0 errors/warnings), and live-reverified on both affected cards -- the duplicate chips are gone. The judge also correctly spotted a related, subtler issue: the Admin edit form shows a bare lowercase 'components' label beside a properly humanized 'Package Label' -- traced to the same labelTemplate ('{value.length} components') being reused for the shared editor's label-stripping logic, which only cleans trailing punctuation and leaves a lowercase leading-placeholder template's trailing word uncleaned. This is a genuine, minor, shared-code label-derivation gap, left open (not fixed this pass) since a rushed fix risks affecting every other community's edit-form labels; documented for a future ticket. The remaining findings (launcher truncation, package-card missing headings, replay-state legibility, messages-empty no-action, Admin FAB overlap) are already-established deferred UX-polish patterns from prior communities' closures.

directQuestionAnswers.question: Why does 'Redacted' render cleanly humanized while 'components' does not, from templates that look similar?
directQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: protectedFieldsToRedact's labelTemplate is 'Redacted: {value.length}' (placeholder at the end); components' labelTemplate is '{value.length} components' (placeholder at the start)
directQuestionAnswers.why: The shared editor's label-stripping regex only trims trailing colons/dashes after removing the placeholder. A trailing-placeholder template leaves a clean leading word ('Redacted'); a leading-placeholder template leaves an uncleaned lowercase trailing word ('components'). This is the precise mechanism, confirmed by source read, not a guess.

findings.title: Redundant componentCount formula field duplicated the component-count chip (fixed)
findings.description: Both export-package and export-schema-listing declared a formula field (componentCount = size(includedComponents)/size(components)) whose labelTemplate ('{value} components') was near-identical to, and whose displayContexts overlapped with, the underlying list field's own labelTemplate ('{value.length} components'). Both rendered the same text on the same card, producing a literal duplicate chip on the community-backup card ('4 components' x2) and the partner-handoff card ('2 components' x2).
findings.requiredFix: Fixed: removed the redundant componentCount fields from both workflow types' instanceDataSchema, since the underlying list field already conveys the count via its own labelTemplate. Re-validated (0 errors/warnings) and live-reverified on both cards.

findings.title: Edit-form labels derived from leading-placeholder labelTemplates render as uncleaned lowercase text
findings.description: The Admin edit form for 'Partner community handoff' shows 'Package Label' (properly humanized) directly above 'components' (raw lowercase). Traced to the shared editor's label-stripping logic (_editorLabel in part26_generic_instance_card.dart), which strips {value}/{value.length} placeholders and trims only trailing punctuation. A trailing-placeholder template like 'Redacted: {value.length}' cleans to 'Redacted'; a leading-placeholder template like '{value.length} components' leaves the uncleaned trailing word 'components' since there's no trailing punctuation to trim.
findings.requiredFix: Deferred: would need a shared-code fix to _editorLabel (e.g. capitalize the stripped remainder, or fall back to the humanized field key whenever the stripped label doesn't look already-proper), which could affect every community's edit forms -- not fixed this pass given the blast radius, recommended for a dedicated future ticket.
